# Project Overview

**Tech Stack:**

- **Framework**: TanStack Start (Solid.js adapter) with Vite + Nitro for SSR
- **Styling**: PandaCSS (build-time atomic CSS with full type safety)
- **Routing**: TanStack Router with file-based routing
- **Validation**: Zod (TypeScript-first schema validation)
- **Linting/Format**: Biome (unified toolchain for linting and formatting)
- **Env Management**: `@t3-oss/env-core` with client-only prefix `VITE_`
